area: Configuration backups, diff, restore, clone and templates (ZIA, ZPA, Client Connector)
title: Backups with secrets masked, field-level diff, restore and cross-tenant clone through the write gates, templates, cache, schedules

checks.what: Every catalogue service and method exists in zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3
Secret canaries (PSK, tokens, passwords, API keys) never reach a backup, cache, template, plan, result, record, log or audit entry
Backups, caches and templates are owner-only files beside the profile store (0600 / 0700)
Hostile backup and template files are refused (size, nesting, format, version, type keys, references, NaN)
Diff oracle: field-level diff of hand-made backups is exact; volatile fields and ignore patterns left out
Dependency order: dependencies created first, deletes reversed (ZIA, ZPA, Client Connector)
Id remapping by name, including DLP engine expressions and objects created in the same run
Conflict guard: re-read before each write; a changed object stops the run before it is overwritten
First failure stops the run; nothing activated; Undo covers what was applied
Undo exactness: tenant state after Undo equals the original, compared by name
Deletes need DELETE n OBJECTS; a fresh automatic backup is saved before any write, or nothing is written
Entitlement on the target: a clone or template writes only to the tenant of the saved profile the person has open; 'same' must be the backup's tenant
Rehearsal (sample tenant, snapshot or backup) never builds a client and can never be applied
Scheduled backups only read, only the profile's scope, never for a profile without a remembered secret; retention kept
Licence gap between source and target blocks a clone until acknowledged
Opt-in rollback of a failed run through the recorded inverse; re-push plan offered
Per-key settings merge; proxy chaining objects with a manual-step report

findings.title: A template made from an in-memory (unmasked) backup kept a secret-named field's value
findings.fix: make_template masks the backup again and drops every secret-named field whatever its value

findings.title: A boolean field named like a reference (zscalerIncidentReceiver) was read as an object id, so every DLP rule looked unclonable
findings.fix: booleans are never references; the field is no longer listed as one

findings.title: Gap closed: the other configuration tool restored and cloned without a fresh target backup, a typed delete phrase, a target entitlement check or an exact Undo; this app now does all of it on the Bulk changes engine
